package.description: Typewriter. Ring-binder. Scrapbook. Scrivener combines all the tools you need to craft your first draft, from nascent notion to final full stop.

en-US.description: Typewriter. Ring-binder. Scrapbook. Scrivener combines all the tools you need to craft your first draft, from nascent notion to final full stop.
en-US.longDescription: Scrivener is the go-to app for writers of all kinds, used every day by best-selling novelists, screenwriters, non-fiction writers, students, academics, lawyers, journalists, translators and more. Scrivener won’t tell you how to write—it simply provides everything you need to start writing and keep writing.
en-US.name: Scrivener

zh-CN.description: 从打字机，于活页夹，至剪贴簿，Scrivener 汇集了从最初的构思到最终的句点，撰写初稿所需的一切工具。
zh-CN.longDescription: Scrivener 是各类写作者的首选应用程序，每天都有畅销小说家、编剧、非虚构作家、学生、学者、律师、记者、翻译人员等在使用。Scrivener 不会告诉你该如何写作——它只是为你提供开始写作并持续写下去所需的一切。
